name: Hamish McTavish
bio:
Hamish McTavish practically grew up in the pit lane. His father was a mechanic for a touring car team, and Hamish spent his weekends immersed in the sights, sounds, and smells of motorsport. He started as a gofer, fetching parts and cleaning tools, but quickly demonstrated a knack for organization and a meticulous attention to detail. This led him to logistics, where he's been a key player for over two decades, ensuring everything arrives on time and in perfect condition.

He's known for his calm demeanor and ability to handle even the most stressful situations with a level head. Hamish is a firm believer in thorough planning and clear communication, which he sees as essential to preventing costly delays and ensuring a smooth operation. His approach is pragmatic and results-oriented, always focused on finding the most efficient and effective solutions.

What sets Hamish apart is his old-school approach combined with modern techniques. He still keeps a detailed paper notebook alongside his digital systems, allowing him to track every detail. He's a walking encyclopedia of motorsport logistics, and his experience is invaluable to any team that values precision and reliability.

physical.description: Hamish is a solidly built man with a friendly face and a no-nonsense air.

quirks: Insists on using a specific brand of duct tape.
Hums quietly while double-checking inventory lists.
